title: strays() only understands pixels, so a rem-sized project gets no findings
request: In src/code/agent/coherence.ts, strays() only understands pixel values, so a project that sizes everything in rem gets no near-miss findings at all. Make it understand rem too (1rem = 16px), comparing both units in one space, so a 0.8125rem used once is reported as a near-miss of a 0.75rem used many times - and so a rem value can be a near-miss of a px one. Keep the behaviour for pixels exactly as it is, and report each value in the unit it was written in.

validated.note: the project's own suite with the hidden files: 9026 pass, 249 already failing, none newly broken
